purpose: Actual findings and fixes during development. This log records assistant work; it is not a claim that the repository owner discovered or fixed these issues.

findings.title: Image processing dependency was behind its security fixes
findings.foundBy: Assistant running npm audit after the first install
findings.cause: The initial Sharp version range stayed on 0.34, which excluded newer fixes in its image decoding libraries.
findings.change: Updated Sharp to 0.35.5 before adding the upload pipeline.
findings.verification: npm install completed with zero reported vulnerabilities.
findings.discussion: Explain why a dependency range can prevent a security update, and how decoding untrusted image files changes the importance of the dependency.
